dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what do people do at Songkran?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt duː ˈpiːpəl ˈduː ət ˈsɔːŋkrɑːn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: People throw water at their friends!
dialogue.reading: ˈpiːpəl ˈθroʊ ˈwɔːtər ət ðɛr ˈfrɛndz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's the Thai New Year, and April is the hottest month of the year!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ðə ˈtaɪ ˈnuː ˈjɪr, ənd ˈeɪprəl ɪz ðə ˈhɑːtɪst ˈmʌnθ əv ðə ˈjɪr!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Do you celebrate it with your family?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈsɛləbreɪt ɪt wɪð jʊr ˈfæməli?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. We go to the temple, and we pour water on our grandparents' hands.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. wiː ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈtɛmpəl, ənd wiː ˈpɔːr ˈwɔːtər ɑːn aʊər ˈɡrænpɛrənts ˈhændz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it is. It's my favorite festival.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪt ˈɪz. ɪts maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈfɛstɪvəl.
